result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.invert_node_selection()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Invert node selection (select unselected, unselect selected). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L6235-L6270){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.invert_node_selection() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Toggles the selection state of all nodes: currently selected nodes become unselected, and unselected nodes become selected. Useful for getting the complement of a selection. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Get complement of a selection: ::: {#bb94b816 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_path_graph(10) .select_nodes_by_degree(max_degree=1) # Select endpoints .invert_node_selection() # Select middle nodes ) # Middle 8 nodes now selected count = graph.count_selected_nodes() # Returns 8 count ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 8 ``` ::: :::
